misconceptions.statement: A liquid has a fixed shape.
misconceptions.distractor: A liquid keeps its own fixed shape regardless of its container.

misconceptions.statement: A solid can easily change its volume to fit a container.
misconceptions.distractor: A solid changes its volume to fill the container it is placed in.

misconceptions.statement: When water evaporates it disappears and stops existing.
misconceptions.distractor: The water disappears completely and no longer exists after it evaporates.

misconceptions.statement: Melting and dissolving are the same process.
misconceptions.distractor: An ice cube in a glass of water melts by dissolving into the water.

misconceptions.statement: The bubbles in boiling water are made of air.
misconceptions.distractor: The bubbles formed in boiling water are bubbles of air.

misconceptions.statement: A bulb lights up even in an open circuit.
misconceptions.distractor: The bulb still lights up when the circuit is open.

misconceptions.statement: Electric current is used up by the bulb so less returns to the battery.
misconceptions.distractor: Current is used up by the bulb, so less current flows back to the battery.

misconceptions.statement: Plastic is a good conductor of electricity.
misconceptions.distractor: Plastic is a good conductor of electricity.

misconceptions.statement: Every non-metal is an electrical insulator.
misconceptions.distractor: All non-metals, including graphite, cannot conduct electricity.
A magnet attracts all metals, including aluminium and copper.

misconceptions.statement: A larger magnet is always stronger than a smaller one.
misconceptions.distractor: A bigger magnet is always stronger than a smaller magnet.
Two north poles placed near each other will attract.
All metals are attracted to a magnet.

misconceptions.statement: A heavier object always falls faster than a lighter one.
misconceptions.distractor: A heavier object always falls to the ground faster than a lighter one.

misconceptions.statement: Friction is always undesirable and serves no useful purpose.
misconceptions.distractor: Friction is always a nuisance and is never useful.

misconceptions.statement: Mass and weight are the same thing.
misconceptions.distractor: The mass of an object becomes smaller when it is taken to the Moon.
